stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2023 entering class); exact counts. SAIC does not publish a Common Data Set on saic.edu (no link on its facts-and-figures or consumer-information pages), so the GPA breakdown, residency and international applicant and admit counts are not shown. College Navigator for fall 2024 shows 6,626 applicants and 77% admitted, 12% of those admitted enrolled (percentages only). IPEDS reports no SAT or ACT scores for SAIC, so no test-score ranges are shown. Undergraduate enrollment (2,805) is the fall 2024 figure; the nonresident count (821 of 2,762 undergraduates) is from IPEDS fall 2023 (EF2023A), and College Navigator lists U.S. nonresident students at 28% of fall 2024 undergraduates.
